name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin O2 Disposable | Kyoho
description: Kyoho Grapes find their origin in Japan and are known for their rich and sweet taste. Our creation is a delicious cross of Grape ZODA #7 and an Oishii male, bred and hunted in house by the Apex team! Kyoho rosin is true to its namesake and is packed with tons of candy grape notes, with a finish of rubber cement. The rosin produced is truly unique to Apex Solventless and is the proud product of several years of hunts!
